name: Animal Haven
neighborhoods: Manhattan (SoHo/Little Italy) shelter; serves NYC + Tri-State
notes:
Established 501(c)(3) since 1967 (EIN 11-6101487), NYS RR086, 4-star Charity Navigator. Limited-admission Manhattan shelter/adoption center (cats + dogs) with behavior intervention + mobile adoption van. Accepts owner surrender via intake form. Not a TNR field group but a major Manhattan adoption + surrender-alternative resource. Verified 2026-08-26. Intake: Adoption Interest Form + Animal Intake (surrender) Form on site Intake: walk-in adoptions during hours Other channel: 200 Centre St, NY 10013 (closed Mon; phones 12-7 daily)

501(c)(3) since 1967, one of NYC's most established no-kill shelters. WALK-IN adoption center at 251 Centre St, SoHo 10013 (5 days/wk, weekend appts) + mobile adoption van. Dogs and cats; in-house behavior-intervention program (Behavior Buddies) that works with dogs needing behavior support. Animals stay as long as it takes. Surrender: read their rehoming resources first, then contact. Email: (via site contact form) Intake: walk-in 5 days/wk, appts weekends
